title: Lost Above the Clouds
logline: Prince Firuz finally brings the flying wooden horse down, lands at dusk on the roof of a palace in an unknown city, wins the trust of its princess by making the horse hover, and leaves with a password and a hand-drawn map so that he can find her again.
moral: Courtesy and honesty turn a stranger into a friend; and a careful traveller marks the way back before leaving.
tone: Relief, then a gentle moonlit comedy of manners (caught on a roof with a cup of water), wonder, a quiet tenderness, a brisk scare, and a wistful open ending.

beats.summary: The cliffhanger of episode 1 is paid off: he turns the hidden lever.
The horse descends through the clouds; relief.
A strange country below: deserts, rivers, nameless cities.
He chooses the roof of a tall palace.
Touchdown on the roof at dusk.
Horse tethered, he tiptoes off for water and a way down; a tile clacks.
The princess comes out with her maid and a lamp.
Both sides are startled: a stranger and a wooden horse.
Who are you, and how did you get here?
He explains with a bow and pictures: the horse flew him away.
She inspects the statue and decides he is joking.
Proof: the horse rises above the roof and settles.
Her eyes widen; she laughs: the strangest horse in the world.
Later, in the garden, they talk about their countries.
His family is worried; he must go, and promises to return.
Guards approach.
The password: the moon knows the river path.
The landmarks: two towers by the river and a blue dome.
He sketches the map.
He flies off across the moon; she wonders if he will return.

sets.description: The series flight world from HORSE-01 (copy horse_sets.js). Used here with the sunset plate (the closing plate of episode 1), a new 'dusk' plate (blue #4a6ad8 above, mauve #c890d0 and apricot #ffb98a at the horizon, first stars, clouds with rose undersides) and the land plate kingdomBelow variant 'far' widened to 2400 so it can be panned: dune sea with long shadows and a caravan (x 0..800), a braided river with boats and a waterwheel (x 700..1500), three walled towns with domes at x 1300, 1750, 2150; the last is riverCity in miniature (blue dome, two towers, river). Descending grammar: nose down 10 to 15 degrees, clouds scrolling up, cape trailing upward.

Exterior establishing plate of the princess's city at dusk, 1400 x 1500 (camera zoom 0.8 to 0.95). Foreground: the river (pink and silver, 260 wide at the bottom edge) curving from the lower left to the horizon at upper right, boats with lamps. On the river at plate (360, 760) and (470, 760): the TWO TOWERS, slim round rose-stone towers 300 tall, 54 wide, with blue cone caps and a low three-arch bridge between them carrying a row of lamps. Middle: the city, about 40 flat-roofed houses in cream, peach, pink and pale blue with small domes, palms, two minarets, washing lines, smoke threads, windows that light in a wave. On a rise right of centre: the palace, rose stone #e89aa0 (shade #c06a80, trim cream #fff0d8), a long block x 760..1120 with a flat ROOF TERRACE at y 560 (crenellated parapet, the stair pavilion as a small box with a dome at its right end), an arcade of five pointed arches below, and beside it at (640, 560) the BLUE DOME #2a6ae0 (shade #1a48b0, highlight #7ab0ff) r 120 on a drum, gold finial. Sky: dusk plate with the moon low at (1150, 420). Must be clearly a different palace from the king's (cream walls, turquoise domes, minarets): rose walls, one blue dome, two river towers.

The roof terrace of the princess's palace: strip 1600 wide, tiled floor at y 900 (cream and rose checker with a border), sky plate from y -700 so the camera can go to zoom 0.62. Back edge: a crenellated parapet, top y 820 (80 high, merlons 60 wide every 120) with the city visible over it. Left to right: hanging carpets on a line x 150..380 (three, in orange, blue and green stripes, swaying); a potted orange tree at x 300 and another at 1120 (pots 70 high, trees to y 640); the eight-point star tile centred x 640 (the horse's spot); the tether post at x 800 (stone bollard 70 high with a brass ring at y 845); the cat's place on the parapet at x 880; the water jar stand at x 1010 (wooden tripod 60 high, clay jar 90 high, dipper cup on a hook); cushions and a low brass tray table at x 1150; the stair pavilion x 1250..1520: rose stone box, top y 560, small blue dome on it to y 470, arched door opening x 1330..1450 (top y 660, wooden leaf hinged on the right, opening outward), a small arched window above the door centred (1390, 600), 70 x 60; two roof lanterns on brackets at x 560 and 1240 (y 700). Behind the parapet: at the left the main BLUE DOME, centre x 330, drum top y 760, r 240, top y 520, gold finial to y 430; beyond, three parallax layers of city roofs with lit windows, palms and a minaret; the river as a band at y 700..760 on the far layer; the TWO TOWERS with their bridge at x 1000 and 1120 (tops y 540); the large warm moon r 95 at (860, 210) after dusk. Plates: 'dusk' (as riverCity) cross-fading over 28.2 to 31 into 'warmNight' (sky deep blue #2a3f9a at the top to lighter violet-blue #6a78d8 and a peach band #ffc8a0 at the horizon, cream moon #ffeab8 with a soft halo, about 40 stars, clouds with moonlit edges; floor and walls repainted lighter and bluer but still rose and cream; warm lamp pools). No tint over the characters.

The princess's palace garden at night: build it as the planned palaceGarden function with variant 'princess' (strip 1600 wide, ground y 900, sky from y -700), warmNight plate. Left: the rose palace wall x 0..440 with the stair arch (opening x 60..220, top y 620, stairs seen going up inside), wall top (the roof edge) at y 380 with the parapet, the ebony horse standing small on the roof at x 300 (s 0.45), and the blue dome rising behind (centre 330, r 150, top y 130). Lawn with a tiled path; a jasmine arch at x 470; octagonal tiled fountain at x 620 (basin 180 wide, rim y 862, jet to y 720, three drawings); lantern poles at x 480 and 1060 (lamp y 640, a hook for the maid's lamp at y 700 on the first); the stone bench at x 900 (260 wide, seat top y 852, used with person sit seat 'bench'); orange trees at x 760 and 1180 (tops y 560); flower beds (roses, white lilies), stones, a small frog on the fountain rim; a clipped hedge along the back, top y 760, with a gate opening x 1380..1500 (arched trellis, top y 620) at the right. Beyond the hedge: the river band y 690..760 with boats, the bridge and the TWO TOWERS at x 1150 and 1290 (tops y 420), far city lights, hills; the moon r 95 at (1000, 150) with its reflection on the river (moonPath). Live parts: fountain, fireflies (12, seeded), petals, lantern flames, river glints, clouds crossing the moon.

subtitles.en: Prince Firuz felt the hidden lever and turned it slowly.|At last the wooden horse began to descend. The prince sighed with relief|and saw wide deserts, rivers, and cities whose names he did not know.

subtitles.en: He chose the roof of a tall palace in a distant city and landed the horse there at dusk.|Seeing nobody at first, he tied it with a rope and quietly searched for water and a safe route.

subtitles.en: The palace princess heard footsteps on the roof and came out with a servant carrying a lamp.|Surprised to see a stranger beside a wooden horse, she cautiously asked,|“Who are you, and how did you get here?”

subtitles.en: Firuz bowed respectfully and explained that he was the son of a distant king,|and that the horse had flown him far from home before he learned how to return.|The princess thought he was joking.

subtitles.en: Firuz thanked her and sketched the palace, towers, dome, and river route.|He flew off as the princess wondered whether he would return.

new_assets.description: Roof terrace of the princess's palace, 1600 wide, with parapet, tether post, jar stand, stair pavilion with an opening door and window, the blue dome behind, a three-layer city panorama with the river and the two towers, dusk and warmNight plates (dimensions in sets). Returns anchors {star, post, ring, jar, catSpot, door {x0, x1, top}, window, parapetY, dome, towers, moon}. Used again in episodes 3 to 5.
new_assets.implementation: Baked plates as in ALI-01-ANIME ab_sets.js and HORSE-01 horse_sets.js: sky per time of day (gradient, soft clouds, stars, moon with halo), far city in three parallax layers (flat house blocks with seeded lit windows, palms from palmTree, a minaret), dome with celShade (hard shade crescent and a highlight that can slide), parapet and floor tiles, then live cels: carpets as sine ribbons, lantern flames, townDoor for the pavilion door (open 0..1) and townWindow for its window (lit, inside callback for the princess bust). A front pass redraws one orange-tree pot and the near parapet corner for depth.

new_assets.name: riverCity
new_assets.description: Exterior wide of the river city with the rose palace, its roof terrace, the blue dome, the two river towers with their bridge and the curving river (dimensions in sets); also drawn at small scale as the third town of kingdomBelow variant far, and as the model for the map sketch. Reused whenever the series returns to this city.
new_assets.implementation: riverCity(ctx, t, {u, lit: 0..1}) from one baked plate per time of day: river as a tapered polygon with a gradient and live glint dashes; houses by a seeded loop (rect, optional dome, 2 to 4 windows whose light switches on when lit passes the house's seeded threshold); palace, dome and towers as a shared function princessPalace(ctx, x, y, s, {detail}) built from celShade shapes, called here at s 1, in the far layer of palaceRoof and princessGarden for the towers, and at s 0.12 in kingdomBelow.

new_assets.name: palaceGarden (variant princess)
new_assets.description: The planned palaceGarden strip in a 'princess' night variant: stair arch and palace wall with the roof above, fountain, bench, lantern poles, hedge with a gate, river with towers and moon beyond (dimensions in sets, id princessGarden). Returns anchors {arch, fountain, bench {x, seatY}, hook, gate, hedgeY, towers, moon}.
new_assets.implementation: Same structure as the HORSE-01 palaceGarden (baked sky, far layer, wall, lawn with dressing, live fountain and lamps, front pass for the hedge so guards can be clipped behind it), with the rose palette, the octagonal fountain and the warmNight plate. The hedge is a separate front layer: draw the guards, then the hedge, then the garden cast.

new_assets.name: moonPath
new_assets.description: The moon reflection on the river, and the visual form of the password: at k 0 about 14 scattered warm glint dashes under the moon; at k 1 they line up into one tapering gold path along the river centre line between the two towers.
new_assets.implementation: moonPath(ctx, pts, t, k): pts is the river centre line (4 to 6 points); each dash has a seeded scatter offset multiplied by (1 - k) and a small shimmer on t; drawn additively in #ffe9a8 with a soft halo (background light, so it may glow).

new_assets.name: mapSketch (scroll)
new_assets.description: The planned scroll with an open state, plus a callout card on which six groups of charcoal strokes draw on with k 0..1 (palace, towers, dome, river, road with arrow, moon).
new_assets.implementation: Each stroke group is a polyline revealed by length with K.beat; the card is a rounded rect with a seeded ragged edge and a tail triangle to the scroll; hand on twos near the stroke end (handInsert at s 0.5 with a charcoal stick).

new_assets.name: tetherRope, oilLamp (lantern, lampGlow), waterJar
new_assets.description: Three small props (sizes in props): the tether rope with sag and taut, the planned oilLamp as a carried lantern with a floor light pool, the water jar on a stand with a dipper cup.
new_assets.implementation: Rope: quadratic curve through a, b with a sag control point, stroked twice (dark then straw) plus twist ticks; lamp: celShade frame, amber pane, flame of two flat shapes on celStep(t, 8), lampGlow as a radial gradient drawn on the floor under the cast (background light); jar: celShade ellipse body, neck, band, hard highlight.

new_assets.name: person costume preset 'guard'
new_assets.description: The guard preset already planned by other stories (pointed helmet with neck cloth, short tunic, sash, hold:'spear'); here royal blue with silver helmets, one carrying a torch.
new_assets.implementation: If the preset is not in the Library yet, build it in the story on the person costume layer with pal overrides and a helmet drawn over the head (cone with a nose bar and neck cloth); torch as a stick with a three-shape flame on threes and an orange lampGlow.

owner_questions: The film ends on TO BE CONTINUED... as decided for the series; the title card shows LOST ABOVE THE CLOUDS with the Arabic title line in Lalezar (default: as described).
The princess is not named in the script, so no name label is shown; she wears the turquoise, white veil and rose sash reserved in the series bible (default: unnamed).

Her palace is drawn as rose stone with one blue dome and two towers by a river, deliberately unlike Firuz's home palace, and the same drawing serves as the landmark he must find again (default: keep).

English balloons are short versions of the quoted lines: WHO ARE YOU? / HOW DID YOU GET HERE? / THE STRANGEST HORSE IN THE WORLD! / IF YOU RETURN, SAY: / THE MOON KNOWS THE RIVER'S PATH / THEN I WILL KNOW YOU; plus one invented balloon YOU ARE JOKING! for her reported thought (default: keep all).

Added business not in the script: a roof cat, a loose tile that goes CLACK! (the footsteps she hears), Firuz caught holding the water cup, the maid hiding behind the lamp, and the two guards arriving on the roof just too late and shrugging (default: keep, all short).
Firuz's reported explanations (P4, P6) are shown as picture clouds with his father the king and the toy palace from episode 1, without text (default: pictures only).

The moon reflection on the river turns into a straight gold path when the password is spoken, and the two towers and the dome get the labels TWO TOWERS and BLUE DOME (default: keep, they set up the return in a later episode).

The garden conversation ends on the roof: after the password the three run up the stairs, so that the landmarks are pointed out from above and the horse is at hand (the script does not say where she describes them; default: roof).
There is one face close-up in the film: the princess eyes at 88.3 to 90.6 with the horse reflected in them (default: keep as the single peak close-up).

SCRIPT: the English of P4 adds "far from home" and drops the Arabic "she looked at the strange machine" and "at first"; the English of P6 adds "to reassure them" and "again". Both languages are kept verbatim.
implementation_notes: Style cel-anime-80s: read Library/styles/cel-anime-80s/look.md (owner direction first) and follow ALI-01-ANIME v4 and HORSE-01. Copy HORSE-01 src files horse_kit.js (ebonyHorse, flyRig, firuzCape, handInsert, powerOn), horse_sets.js (skyFlight, kingdomBelow, palaceToy, palaceGarden) and horse_cast.js (Firuz and king settings) once they exist; do not redraw them. Put the new series drawings in the same files (princessPalace, palaceRoof, riverCity, moonPath) so episodes 3 to 5 can copy them.

Frame order: plate, lamp and moon light on the background, cels, rim light, lettering, S.finish last. Night is the repainted warmNight plate plus warm lamp pools; never a tint or dark pass over the cast. Rim only: castFinish(ctx, x, y, w, h, draw, {rim: "#ffd27a", light: [1, 0]}) on the lamp side, {rim: "#bfd8ff", light: [-1, -1]} on the moon side.
Characters on twos: tc = celStep(t, THEME.celFps) for every pose channel; blinks, lip flaps, flames and the fountain on celStep(t, 8). Camera, plates, clouds, glints, moonPath and lampGlow on t.
S1 must match the last frame of HORSE-01 (same rig position, sunset plate, hand near the lever) before the title appears; the insert at 1.9 to 5.6 is the same ebonyHorse at s 4.2 with handInsert.
Descent (S2): flyRig pitch -12 through flow; skyFlight vy negative (clouds up); the deck covers the whole frame from 8.7 to 9.3 and the plate swap to dusk happens under it.

Landing and hover: the horse never squashes. Landing 25.72 to 27.46: y by kfn with three small steps at 26.82, 27.0, 27.2; groundShadow(ctx, 640, 900, 260, lift). Hover 83.52 to 87.24: lift = flow([[83.52, 0], [84.8, 150], [86.6, 150], [87.24, 0]]) plus idleSway(tc, 3, 6, 2.6) while up.

Riders: rideOn(ctx, ebonyHorse, P, personP, {name: "horse", reins: false}); mount and dismount with anticipate, hop and landSquash on the near side at x + 60. On the ground the cape hangs (firuzCape hang) and follows turns with lagged.

Tiptoe (34.76 to 39.0): xF = kfn([[34.76, 820], [36.9, 990], [37.5, 1090], [39.2, 1120]]) with walk(xF, tc) at amp 1.3 and footfalls; the CLACK at 39.3 is the last footfall plus impactSquash. Princess walk-out: xP = kfn([[44.5, 1400], [45.5, 1300]]).

Door and window: townDoor(ctx, 1330, 1450, 660, 900, open, {arch: true, hinge: "right"}) with a leafOnly front pass so the maid can peek round the leaf; townWindow with lit and an inside callback drawing the princess bust at 40.22 to 44.0.
Bench: person {sit: 1, seat: "bench"} for both at y 900 with the bench drawn by the set (seat top y 852); stand up at 117.0 with a pop (sq 1.05).

Guards behind the hedge: draw them before the hedge front layer; walk(xG, tc) with a phase offset of half a cycle between the two; torch lampGlow in orange. They are never in sync with each other or with the maid.

Balloons: S.label(ctx, text, x, y, p, {balloon: true, to: [headX, headY]}) in the sky band (panel y 110..340), long lines on two rows, at least 28 px at 1280 x 720 scale; the password balloon uses the gold text colour. Tags (???, THAT ROOF!, UP, DOWN, TWO TOWERS, BLUE DOME) are plain S.label boxes with S.arrow. 20 lettering items in total: do not add more.

S.transition(ctx, ..., {rect: panel, caption: 'LATER, IN THE GARDEN...'}) from 97.95 to 98.84 with the set swap at 98.35. No S.emphasis impact frame in this episode (it is a gentle one); the peak is the eye close-up at 88.3.

Sound: 8 effects, master 0.6, each under 0.5 s and inside a listed pause: chime 20.6, blip 39.5 (the tile), blip 60.3, blip 79.05, glitch 98.35, chime 114.3, blip 132.35, chime 147.25 (after the last word); tape bed under everything. The hover and take-off are silent (no pause there).
DUR = 151.49 (147.49 + 4.0). Subtitles are the chunks of chunks_ar.txt / chunks_en.txt (copied into this file), already timed in timing.json.

Run the alive checklist on contact sheets of: the descent (5.8 to 12.5), the landing and tiptoe (25.7 to 40.2), the meeting (48.8 to 60.8), the hover (83.5 to 87.9), the bench (98.8 to 114.7) and the ending (140.6 to 151.5).
warnings: This episode depends on HORSE-01 drawings (ebonyHorse, flyRig, firuzCape, handInsert, skyFlight, palaceToy, cast settings). If HORSE-01 src is not split into horse_kit.js / horse_sets.js / horse_cast.js yet, copy the functions from its scene file and keep their names.

Night scenes are 100 of the 151 seconds. They must stay light, warm and multi-coloured (owner direction): rose walls, blue dome, turquoise princess, crimson cape and lavender maid all keep their own colours; check stills at 50, 85, 105 and 145 s for any monochrome or purple cast.

The ebony horse against the night sky and the blue dome can lose its legs: keep the lifted ebony #3a3448 with the #6a6288 highlight edge and the brass joints, and place it against the lighter horizon band or the lamp pool, never against the darkest sky.

The person figure is front-facing: 'seen from behind at the parapet' (S16, S18) is staged as three-quarter figures beside the parapet with gaze and a raised arm toward the skyline, not a true back view.
The planned 'guard' costume preset may not exist in the Library yet; build it in the story if needed.
Three new sets is the heavy part of this episode; palaceRoof carries 100 seconds and deserves the most care. riverCity and princessGarden share princessPalace, the towers and the river code.
Only seven pauses of 0.6 s or more: 8 effects, none during speech.
